description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hiththetiya, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820003 (24/0978)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of land owners, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and is published in "PART III - LANDS" section of the gazette.
